name: ST L293D PDIP-16
uncertainty: Body 19.8 x 6.35 mm is the TI L293D DIP-16 published body size; the ST PDIP-16 package drawing gives D = 20.0 mm max and e = 2.54 mm, e1 = 17.78 mm. Modelled with D = 19.8 mm, row spacing 7.62 mm, lead length 3.6 mm; pin-1 notch is at the catalogue top-view end.
mass_source: Estimated from 19.8 x 6.35 x 4.6 mm epoxy DIP body (density ~1.2 g/cm3). Not a manufacturer figure.
